title: Separate public ROM coverage from detailed local reports
changes: Keep full coverage HTML and JSON under target by default and publish an explicit allowlisted aggregate overview without per-resource ranges or audit labels.
Preserve the previously generated detailed report locally and reject repository docs as the full-report output in the standard launchers.
validation: Preserved HTML and JSON byte-for-byte before publication, verified their embedded data agree, and matched all six public totals to the local snapshot.
Passed 28 coverage and audit tests, including public-export regression tests, and nine Docker launcher tests with mocked Docker.
limitations: Windows PowerShell and Docker Desktop execution were not available for validation. Historical Git commits and already-published Pages content require independent review.
